critical_code_review_comments: useMarketsMcap hook polls every 60s with no visibility-change guard — on long-open tabs this is a small background cost but harmless; consider pausing on document.hidden.
The mcap override is applied in two places (Explore row + Home card). Consider centralizing via a mapDesk(desk, marketsMcap) util to prevent future drift if a third surface is added.

rca of the issue: Previous bug: masked $MARKETS rows showed upstream MAKERS token mcap (~$77.8K/$502.4K) because UI used market.mcapUsd from relay desks (upstream value). Fix: backend market_prices endpoint now surfaces GeckoTerminal pool mcapUsd for arbitrary mint; useMarketsMcap hook fetches CA mcap and Explore/Home override market.mcapUsd for desks where mint === PLATFORM_MINT. Verified correct: both $MARKETS rows now show $20.6K matching CA.
